statement_summary: SP 800-171 program for all CUI systems
CUI only inside the enclave or on controlled paper; SSP updated before boundary changes
Annual risk assessment using SP 800-30
Risk acceptance authority by level
Sanctions
Annual self-assessment; monthly POA&M review; accurate SPRS score; evidence-based affirmation
FedRAMP Moderate-equivalent cloud; no flowdown, no CUI
Unique accounts including MES and DNC; no shared logins
U.S.-person confirmation before enclave access
Least privilege; no local admin for engineers; operators cannot edit NC programs
MFA on all enclave accounts including MES; hardware keys for admins
Same-day access removal; 45-day inactivity disable
Quarterly access reviews
14-character passwords; service credentials in key vault
Remote access only through the virtual desktop gateway
No external systems or public AI with CUI
Visitor log and escort; foreign-person visit approval
Report suspected incidents within 1 hour
Report to DoD through DIBNet within 72 hours; incident number to prime
Two trained reporters with medium assurance certificates
Preserve images and monitoring data for 90 days; 1-year log retention
Annual tabletop with DIBNet drill
CUI banner and distribution statement on company-created CUI
FIPS-validated encryption for CUI at rest and in transit
Printed CUI stored in cabinets and sealed for transport
Paper CUI shredded; media sanitized before leaving company control
Only labeled, inventoried, scanned USB drives
Encrypted, separated, tested backups
Annual CUI, insider threat, and role-based training
No unapproved software or removable storage
Approved generative AI tools only; never CUI in public AI
